title: Account and sign-in
lede: Where the portal is, how sign-in works, and the one error you are likely to hit.

items.v: UH single sign-on. There is no separate ExamSoft password.
Your @hawaii.edu address, because SSO matches on it

blocks.title: Check the article title before you trust it
blocks.text: ExamSoft publishes two parallel sets of documentation. The Enterprise articles describe screens JABSOM does not have. Every vendor link on this page is the Legacy version. If you search the support site yourself, look for a title starting with **Legacy Portal**.

The error you will probably see is **"No associated ExamSoft account found"**. It means the External ID on your ExamSoft account does not match the identifier UH single sign-on is sending. Your password is fine and your browser is fine.

blocks.title: An incognito window will not fix this
blocks.text: Someone has to correct the External ID field on your account from the admin side. Email Jesse Thompson at [jessetho@hawaii.edu](mailto:jessetho@hawaii.edu) and it gets fixed in the portal. Retrying in a private window only costs you time.
ExamSoft's own SSO documentation sometimes calls this field the ePPN ID.
